manufactureInstallation.guardrail: Generic 3.6 m x 1.1 m exterior guardrail. Closed rectangular galvanized-steel profiles with dielectric powder coat; five welded posts, top and lower rails, vertical pickets, capped rail ends, post base plates, EPDM isolation pads and mechanical anchors. MASTER/LOD0 retain raised weld-fillet strips.
manufactureInstallation.cornerReturn: Independent 1.2 m return module using the same section family, three posts, miter cover, pickets, base plates and anchors. Reversible and not silently fused to the main guardrail.
manufactureInstallation.kerb: Four concrete curb segments with slight outward top fall, exterior drip nib, three actual movement gaps containing recessed sealant and backer rod, plus an inner water-stop detail at near LODs.
manufactureInstallation.interfaces: Diagnostic assembly seats guardrail base plates on the curb top. EPDM isolates coated steel from mineral substrate. Anchor geometry is modeled, but no structural load capacity is claimed.
manufactureInstallation.orientationExposure: Y up; exterior +Z. Top rail and curb crown receive strongest midsummer UV/rain exposure while inner lower faces are sheltered. Lighting is not baked.
manufactureInstallation.agingCausality: No arbitrary rust, rain streaks or mildew. Future wear should concentrate at top-rail UV exposure, fasteners, movement joints, water-stop edge and post-base splash zone.
manufactureInstallation.geometryVsMaterial: Rails, pickets, posts, caps, base plates, weld strips, washers/nuts/studs, curb segments, movement joints and backer rods are geometry. Powder-coat orange peel, zinc spangle, rubber grain and concrete microstructure are material proxies.

assumptions: Dimensions are generic modern references and are not identification of a specific historical Japanese product or SKU.
Powder-coated galvanized-steel construction, base-plate anchor pattern and EPDM isolation are authored modeling assumptions.
LOD3 alternates pickets as a far-distance reduction and therefore requires Unity temporal/LOD-pop verification before benchmark use.

sourceDelivery.repositoryStores: machine-readable authoring data and run evidence; actual OBJ/GLB exports and executed full exporter are delivered outside the repository in the run artifact

nextProductionTarget: If no Unity render appears, add causal post-base splash-zone aging and inspect balcony ceiling/soffit owners before a larger structural batch.
